name: h10_chain_ccpvdz_k
description: #199: h10_chain_ccpvdz_j's molecule, basis and recorded density, with PySCF's get_jk exchange matrix K (vk_il = sum_jk (ij|kl) D_jk) in place of J.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate h10_chain_ccpvdz_k

density_recipe: rhf: PySCF's converged closed-shell RHF density (total, 2 C_occ C_occ^T, symmetrised as (D + D^T) / 2; conv_tol 1e-12, conv_tol_grad 1e-10), recorded; every array is computed from the recorded matrix, which --check holds to 1e-08 of a fresh SCF, not bitwise
